title: Bid Manager
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

· Manage the complete bid lifecycle, from opportunity identification to proposal submission.

· Review and evaluate RFPs, RFQs, EOIs, tenders, and other procurement documents.

· Coordinate with Sales, Technical, Finance, Legal, HR, and Operations teams to gather inputs for bid responses.

· Prepare, edit, and compile technical and commercial proposals in line with customer requirements.

· Develop and maintain bid plans, schedules, compliance matrices, and submission checklists.

· Ensure all bid documents are accurate, compliant, and submitted within stipulated deadlines.

· Coordinate with OEMs, partners, and vendors to obtain quotations, authorizations, certifications, and supporting documents.

· Manage bid portals (Government e-Marketplace, CPP Portal, state procurement portals, and private tender portals).

· Track tender opportunities through various procurement platforms.

· Conduct risk assessments and highlight commercial, contractual, and technical risks.

Interested candidates can share their CV at hr@aipl.net

· Maintain a repository of standard proposal content, templates, case studies, and supporting documents.

· Prepare management reports on bid status, success rates, and pipeline.

· Participate in bid review meetings and post-bid analysis to identify improvement opportunities.

· Ensure confidentiality of bid-related information and documents.

Work Location: In person

title: Sr Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. Adobe is listed as Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” for 20 consecutive years. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.
  
  
Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give global brands everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about transforming how companies interact with customers across every screen.
  
The Opportunity
  
Adobe Experience Platform and Apps powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across channels.
  
  
The Forward Deployed Engineer sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You’ll work directly with Adobe’s strategic customers to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build solutions that accelerate adoption.
  
You’ll operate in a multi-functional Customer Pod with end-to-end ownership, partnering with customers, product teams, and engineers to turn complex problems into working solutions.
  
What You’ll Do
  
Partner with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives.
  
Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes.
  
Investigate and resolve production-level platform issues across data ingestion, identity resolution, journey orchestration, and audience activation.
  
Design and validate enterprise solutions spanning AEP, AJO, Marketo, and adjacent Adobe systems.
  
Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that build customer trust.
  
Prototype, experiment, and iterate rapidly, using AI-assisted tools as part of your everyday workflow.
  
Connect customer needs with product and engineering teams, bringing field insights back into the product roadmap.
  
Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts from discovery through implementation, launch, and expansion.
  
What Success Looks Like
  
We hire for demonstrated impact and experience. You’ll bring a combination of technical depth, customer empathy, and collaborative problem solving.
  
**Hands-on engineering:** You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your architecture decisions are grounded in implementation experience.
  
**Customer empathy:** You understand customers’ goals, constraints, and definitions of success and build trusted relationships through empathy and technical expertise.
  
**Collaboration and communication:** You work effectively with engineers, architects, product managers, and leaders and communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  
**Enterprise architecture:** You design end-to-end solutions across products and systems, considering integration, scale, security, and production requirements.
  
**Data expertise:** You understand how data is structured, modeled, and moved and can evaluate trade-offs in schema design, identity resolution, and data pipelines.
  
**AI fluency and continuous learning:** You embrace AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent to design, prototype, and deliver solutions.
  
**Proactive problem solving:** You identify emerging challenges and take initiative to move them toward resolution.
  
What You Need to Succeed
  
10+ years of experience across solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering.
  
Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science or a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
Experience with CDP, MDM, martech, or data platforms.
  
Experience with data governance, privacy-preserving computation, or secure data collaboration.
  
Familiarity with identity resolution or customer data unification.
  
Experience with workflow orchestration technologies such as Temporal, Step Functions, or similar.
  
Experience contributing to architecture decisions or technical strategy at the team or organizational level.
  
Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud products such as AEP, AJO, Marketo, CJA, or Target is helpful.
  
Experience working in regulated industries such as Financial Services, Healthcare, or Government is also helpful.
  
Why This Team
  
You’ll solve complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact and see your solutions reach production. You’ll combine architecture, engineering, strategy, and customer engagement while working with experienced engineers across Adobe’s global platform teams.
  
You’ll also help shape an engineering engagement model centered on rapid experimentation, customer feedback, and AI-assisted execution.
  
  
Come build the next generation of enterprise customer experiences with us!
  
  
Adobe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status.
  
About Adobe
  
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

title: People Partner, Specialist I

title: R&D Engineering, Sr Engineer
description:
### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You are someone who looks at a test failure and does not just log it, you dig until you understand why it happened and what it means for the next release. Scripting is not a chore for you, it is how you make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human brain. You have spent enough time in labs or codebases to know that quality is not something you test in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.


Data tells you stories. When you see a trend in regression results, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you pull the thread, ask the right questions, and surface what matters. You are comfortable working across teams, translating between what verification found, what design needs to know, and what a release checklist actually requires.


You do not need years of experience to have a point of view. You know when a process is not working and you are not afraid to suggest a better way. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the rigor you bring to testing and automation will directly affect whether those products ship on time and work as promised.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Run kickoff and release meetings across design, verification, and release teams, making sure compliance checkpoints are hit and nothing falls through the cracks
* Execute regression testing on Embedded Memory IP, catch issues before they reach customers, and track results across release cycles
* Analyze test data to spot trends, recurring failures, and process gaps that affect product quality or schedule
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that eliminate manual testing steps and speed up validation workflows
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on quality gates, release criteria, and issue resolution timelines
* Document test results, failure analysis, and process improvements in a way that helps the next engineer understand what happened and why

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Ensure Embedded Memory IP on advanced process nodes ships with zero critical defects, directly affecting customer success and market readiness
* Reduce validation cycle time by automating repetitive test and data collection tasks, freeing engineers to focus on complex debug work
* Surface quality and process issues early in the development cycle, preventing costly delays and rework downstream
* Improve the reliability of regression infrastructure so teams can trust test results and make faster release decisions
* Strengthen compliance and traceability across the release process, reducing risk and audit friction
* Enable smarter decision\-making by turning raw test data into actionable insights for design and verification teams

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role
* Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation
* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Familiarity with regression testing, release processes, or quality management systems is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to work across teams without losing track of details

### **Who You Are**

* You can look at a spreadsheet of test results and spot the one anomaly that matters, not just the loudest failure
* You write scripts that other people can actually read and modify six months later
* You are comfortable running a meeting with senior engineers and keeping it focused without being intimidated
* When a process does not make sense, you ask why before you follow it blindly
* You can explain a technical issue to a release manager in two sentences without losing the nuance
* You stay organized when managing multiple release tracks, test cycles, and compliance checkpoints at once

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Senior Computer Scientist - C++
description:
The Opportunity
  
Adobe builds products that power millions of customer experiences worldwide. Behind these products are sophisticated software systems operating at scale, where performance, reliability, security, and engineering excellence are fundamental requirements.
  
We are looking for a Senior Computer Scientist with deep C\+\+ expertise who enjoys solving complex technical problems and taking ownership of significant areas of the product. You will shape architecture, build high\-performance software, make critical technical decisions, and influence solutions that span components and teams.
  
We value engineers who are self\-driven, proactive, and outcome\-oriented — engineers who challenge assumptions, solve problems at their root, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and take responsibility for making the systems they own better, more reliable, and easier to evolve.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas end\-to\-end — from understanding ambiguous problems and defining the right solution through architecture, implementation, production validation, and long\-term evolution.
  
Design and build high\-performance C\+\+ systems , making thoughtful decisions around architecture, concurrency, memory management, resource utilization, and scalability.
  
Drive technical direction for complex problems — evaluate alternatives, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and influence architecture decisions across components and teams.
  
Solve problems at the root — identify systemic causes rather than treating symptoms, and drive durable solutions that reduce recurring issues and technical debt.
  
Own outcomes, not just tasks — proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities and drive them to closure with minimal direction.
  
Solve complex problems across boundaries , collaborating with engineers, architects, product managers, and other teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
  
Raise the engineering bar through architecture and code reviews, performance optimization, testing, and engineering best practices.
  
Build for operational excellence with strong focus on performance, reliability, security, observability, maintainability, and efficient resource utilization.
  
Be a force multiplier — mentor engineers, share technical expertise, and establish patterns and practices that improve the broader engineering organization.
  
Leverage AI\-assisted engineering to accelerate development and problem solving, improve engineering workflows, and increase team productivity.
  
  

What You Need to Succeed
  
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
10\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience , with a strong track record of owning and delivering complex technical solutions.
  
Deep expertise in C\+\+ , including modern C\+\+, memory management, concurrency, multithreading, STL, and performance optimization.
  
Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, operating systems, and computer science fundamentals .
  
Strong understanding of systems design, distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and performance engineering .
  
Experience designing and building large\-scale, high\-performance software systems .
  
Experience building or operating Distributed systems at scale , with an understanding of multi\-tenancy, scaling, reliability, backward compatibility, security, observability, and capacity planning.

Experience with cloud platforms, distributed infrastructure, and modern software development practices.
  
Strong proficiency in AI\-assisted engineering , leveraging tools such as Claude, Codex, or Copilot to accelerate development, improve problem solving, and enhance engineering productivity.
  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving ability , with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence technical decisions across teams.
  
  

What Success Looks Like
  
Success in this role is not measured only by the features you deliver. You will be successful when you:
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas with minimal direction and strong technical judgment.
  
Turn ambiguous, complex problems into clear technical direction and executable solutions .
  
Make architecture decisions that balance performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long\-term evolution .
  
Solve systemic problems at their root and eliminate recurring sources of complexity, performance issues, and operational risk.
  
Influence technical direction across teams and organizational boundaries through technical depth and credibility.
  
Deliver solutions that materially improve performance, scalability, reliability, quality, or developer productivity .

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
### **Executive Assistant to CEO**

  

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Executive Assistant provides executive support in a one\-on\-one working relationship. The Executive Assistant serves as the primary point of contact for internal and external constituencies on all matters involving the CEO. The Executive Assistant also serves as a liaison to the Core Committee and senior management teams; organizes and coordinates executive outreach and external relations efforts; and oversees special projects. The ideal individual will have the ability to exercise good judgment in a variety of situations, with strong written and verbal communication, administrative, and organizational skills, and the ability to maintain a realistic balance among multiple priorities. The Executive Assistant will have the ability to work independently on projects, from conception to completion, and must be able to work under pressure and travel at times to handle a wide variety of activities and confidential matters with discretion.

 **Specific responsibilities:**

  

* Completes a broad variety of administrative tasks for the CEO, including managing an extremely active calendar of appointments; completing expense reports; composing and preparing correspondence that is sometimes confidential; arranging complex and detailed travel plans, itineraries, and agendas; and compiling documents for travel\-related meetings. Plans, coordinates, and ensures the CEO's schedule is followed and respected. Provides "gatekeeper" and "gateway" roles, creating win\-win situations for direct access to the CEO's time and office

  

* Communicates directly, on behalf of the CEO, with the Core Committee, Administration, HR, Operations, Branches, Zonal managers, Processing, Accounts, legal, etc.

  

* Research prioritizes, and follows up on incoming issues and concerns addressed to the CEO, including those of a sensitive or confidential nature. Determines the appropriate course of action, referral, or response.

  

* Provides a bridge for smooth communication between the CEO and internal departments; demonstrating leadership to maintain credibility, trust, \& support with senior management staff.

  

* Works closely and effectively with the CEO to keep him well informed of upcoming commitments and responsibilities, following up appropriately. Acts as a "barometer," having a sense of the issues taking place in the environment and keeping the CEO updated.

  

* Provides leadership to build relationships crucial to the success of the organization, and manages a variety of projects for the CEO, some of which may have organizational impact.

  

* Completes critical aspects of deliverables with a hands\-on approach, including drafting acknowledgement letters, personal correspondence, and other tasks that facilitate the CEO's ability to effectively lead the company.

  

* Prioritizes conflicting needs; handles matters expeditiously, and proactively, and follows through on projects to successful completion, often with deadline pressures.

 **NB:** The principal responsibilities listed above are an illustrative list and not an exhaustive list. Additional responsibilities will be added from time to time, depending on organizational requirements.

 **KEY SELECTION CRITERIA**

**Qualification**

  

* Any UG degree with relevant experience
* MBA Corporate Governance / Secretarial Course preferred

**Experience**


Minimum of 3 to 5 years’ experience in administration.

**Age**


25–30 years

**Sex**


Female/Male (Preference for Female candidates)

**Computer skills**

* Excellent MS Office, internet and emails

**Language skills**

* Good written and oral communication skills in English.
* Good email\-drafting skills in English
* **Functional skills**
* Good verbal and written communication \& presentation skills with strong business\-related knowledge
* Strong organizational skills that reflect the ability to perform and prioritize multiple tasks seamlessly with excellent attention to detail
* Very strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders, including staff, Core committee, and external partners § Expert level written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated proactive approaches to problem\-solving with strong decision\-making capability
* Emotional maturity
* Proven ability to handle confidential information with discretion, be adaptable to various competing demands, and demonstrate the highest level of customer/client service and response
* Demonstrated ability to achieve high\-performance goals and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Forward\-looking thinker, who actively seeks opportunities and proposes solutions

**Pay Scale**


Rs 3\.6 lakh to 5\.4 lakh per annum

 **Probation**


3 months

 **Training**
